about: The Studio's API (window.EDITOR, qccd/viz/js/editor.js), declared: every function, what it does, and who may call it. use: agent (an agent's `studio` page action may call it), harness (tests and the pointer adapters only), never (the person's files, storage, or a restart). kind (agent verbs): read, view (changes only what is shown), design (changes the device), program, course (changes the canvas to a lesson's). A function added to the API without an entry here, or an entry naming none, fails tests/test_agent_interface.py.

setMode.does: the old mode switch; finishes any gesture in flight (tests call it)

edits.does: the edit log: every change made to the device since it was loaded

problems.does: what is wrong with the device now (geometry rules, structure, refusals)

lints.does: every lint finding, problems and notes together

state.does: the whole current state: the device (nodes, segments, loops, zones) and its builder

ready.does: whether the page finished loading its device and programme

why.does: why the page is not ready, when it is not

hit.does: what is under a pixel; the pointer adapter's hit test

begin.does: start a drag at a pixel

claim.does: the gesture arbiter: which gesture owns a press

claimEvent.does: the arbiter, from a DOM event

hover.does: the hover feedback at a pixel

cursor.does: the CSS cursor the pointer shows

panning.does: whether a pan is in progress

outline.does: the outline drawn around a part

cancelGesture.does: Escape: abandon whatever gesture is live

measureToggle.does: turn the ruler on or off

measureClick.does: add a ruler point at a pixel of the canvas (two points: a distance; three: an angle)

measure.does: the ruler's reading: distance in micrometres and lattice units, angle in degrees

setTrueScale.does: True scale on (one pixel is the same length across and down) or off

refit.does: fit the whole device to the canvas afresh

refitNext.does: make the next rebuild fit the device afresh

physVec.does: a pixel displacement in nanometres, per axis

railAngle.does: the angle between two vectors, in degrees

redraw.does: redraw the static scene from the current layout

lengthNote.does: the note about drawn vs declared segment lengths

groupCheck.does: whether a group of marks can move by an offset without overlapping

keyGesture.does: the verb a key means (the keyboard adapter)

keyHelp.does: every key and gesture the Studio understands, as the guide lists them

helpToggle.does: open or close the guide overlay (?)

helpOn.does: whether the guide overlay is open

nudge.does: move the selection by one step with an arrow key

reconcileLast.does: set the last moved node's segment lengths to what the drawing shows (the L key)

toast.does: show a transient message on the page

subjectOf.does: what a press on a part selects (the whole component, or the part)

selectionNodes.does: the nodes the selection would move

emit.does: the one low-level applier every lane writes through; an agent uses the named design verbs

validate.does: check one edit op without applying it: the problems it would cause

addSite.does: add a trapping site at a position (model units)
addSite.args: x, y, near?: node id, opts?: {kind, zone}

addSegment.does: join two nodes with a rail

removeSelected.does: delete the selection (a site takes its rails with it)

reconcileLengths.does: append segment-length records for a moved node

stampComponent.does: place a whole component with its top-left at (x, y)

components.does: the components available here, with their parameters

instanceMembers.does: every node and segment a placed component owns

instanceAt.does: the placed component a node belongs to

joinPin.does: join a component's pin to a node

pinNode.does: the node behind a component's pin

attachComponent.does: place a component and join one of its pins to a node, as one undoable act
attachComponent.args: name, x, y, quarter, pin, target, opts?

componentParams.does: the parameters currently chosen for a component

variantOf.does: which variant a placed component is

setComponentParam.does: set a component parameter before placing it

arm.does: arm an element tile so the next canvas click places one

stageMark.does: a node's mark on the canvas

nodeRec.does: what the drawing recorded about one node (length, slots, angle)

openForm.does: open one of the Selection panel's forms (a named zone, a row, a block)

menuOpen.does: open the element menu for the part at a pixel (what right-click does)

menuItems.does: the open element menu's actions, each with whether it can run here and why not

menuInvoke.does: run one action of the open element menu

modifyOpen.does: open the Modify panel for the menu's part

modifyApply.does: apply the Modify panel (field name -> value)

modifyExplode.does: the irreversible explode, behind the person's confirmation

insertSiteOn.does: split a rail and put a trapping site into it at a pixel

rewriteBuilder.does: rewrite one builder record (d.site / d.segment / d.loop) by id

notes.does: observations about what is not there yet (not problems)

lintProblems.does: the lint findings that are problems

placeStamp.does: place the armed stamp at a pixel

clickStage.does: a click on the canvas (the pointer adapter)

isStampType.does: whether a type places as a stamp

setViewOnly.does: lock the page to viewing (embedded examples)

sealZones.does: the zones the device's seal declares

canvasHistory.does: how many canvas-level undo and redo steps there are

pressStartCard.does: press a card of the Start panel (a generator, a template or a blank canvas)

setName.does: type the new device's name (what the Start panel's name box does)

zone.does: the zone the next placed site gets; with an argument, choose it

closeLoopFromSelection.does: declare the selected sites, in selection order, as a loop

elementDocs.does: the schema's own description of every element

snapTo.does: snap a point to the lattice

setSnap.does: Snap on (parts land on the lattice) or off

designMode.does: the design mode: sketch or parts

sketchPlan.does: what a sketch would make (sites, corners, refusal) without making it
sketchPlan.args: tool, a: {x, y}, b: {x, y} (model units), mod?

sketchReadout.does: the live sketch preview's numbers and any refusal

sketchCommit.does: make the device parts a sketch plan describes

sketchClick.does: a polyline click at a pixel

sketchFinish.does: finish the polyline sketch, open or closed

sketchDraw.does: draw a shape and make it: the release lays trapping sites one lattice unit apart along what you drew, declares the orbit (a loop) when the shape is closed, and adds a junction where the new rail meets an existing one; a refusal says which rule (e.g. R20, too sharp a corner) and why
sketchDraw.args: tool: 'rect'|'ellipse'|'line'|'poly'; for rect/ellipse/line: from [x, y], to [x, y] (model units); for poly: from = the corner points [[x, y], ...] and to = null; mod: {closed: true} closes a polyline into a loop (a triangle is poly with three corners, closed), {shift: true} makes an ellipse a circle

boundary.does: the frozen mark sizes of the no-overlap boundary

nodeBox.does: a node's box at a position

contactAt.does: the first mark a set of members would touch at an offset

price.does: what the programme costs on this device (cost, steps, time, DACs) or why it cannot be priced

programBreaks.does: why the programme no longer fits the device ([] when it fits)

hardware0.does: the hardware totals of the device as loaded

digest.does: the device's nodes and segments, sorted (a structural summary)

source.does: the device as its builder program (the Device panel's source)

applySource.does: replace the device's builder program with edited text

exportPython.does: the device as a Python listing

schemaErrors.does: why the current state could not be written as an .arch.json ([] when it can)

transaction.does: apply several edit ops as one undoable step

newCanvas.does: start a new blank canvas that keeps the machine's physics; shapes (sketchDraw) and parts are drawn onto it -- for a NEW design, do it on a new draft, not on main

newFromGenerator.does: start a new device from a generator (chain, ring, grid, ...)

newFromTemplate.does: open a shipped device as itself

addNodeAt.does: add a site or junction at model coordinates

joinNodes.does: add a segment between two nodes

closeLoop.does: declare a loop over existing nodes
closeLoop.args: id, walk: node ids, closed, kind?

nameZone.does: declare or change a zone type

zoneFields.does: a zone type's fields, as the form prefills them

postSeedZones.does: zones declared after the device's seal

curveAddPoint.does: add a point to a physics curve

curveRemovePoint.does: remove a point from a physics curve

applyBlock.does: change machine settings of one block (primitives, heating, control, ...)

explodeToExplicit.does: turn a device made by a generator (ring, grid, chain, ...) into its explicit sites, rails and loops, so shapes and parts can be added to it; the device stays the same (in the workspace this is one change set, undoable like any other)

program.does: the hardware programme, one record per instruction

emitProgram.does: append one instruction record to the programme

programSource.does: the programme as source text (the Write panel's language)

applyProgramSource.does: replace the programme with source text

programErrors.does: why statements of the programme could not be lowered

authored.does: whether the programme was written on this page

parseErrors.does: why the Write panel's text could not be parsed

evaluateWrite.does: price, check and play a test programme (what Evaluate does)

problemLine.does: one line describing a problem, for the strip

metricRows.does: the figures the head and the Report show (cost, steps, runtime, n-bar, DACs, ...)

refusedLine.does: the sentence under the picture when a statement was refused ('' when none)

testDrivePlan.does: the smallest programme that exercises this device

testDrive.does: write that programme and play it (Test drive)

pressTestDrive.does: the Test drive button: the verb plus its toast

programToTsir.does: the programme as a TSIR document

exportPair.does: the device and programme files together

rules.does: the hardware rules' verdicts for this programme on this device

ruleCoverage.does: each of the 27 rules: checked here, not checkable here, and why

palette.does: every element the palette offers, generated from the schema

hintFor.does: what a control or part is, in the explain layer's words

hintFrom.does: the hint for a DOM element

stageHint.does: the on-canvas line naming what is under the pointer

explainToggle.does: label the regions of the screen (Explain)

setFold.does: open or close a rail section (row, block, component)

lessonsReady.does: the course data arrived (tutorial.js calls it)

lessonState.does: the open lesson: its stage, whether it passed, the feedback

lessonLoad.does: open a lesson: its device and programme on the canvas

lessonCheck.does: check the lesson's exercise against what the page measures

lessonSolution.does: show the course's own solution, applied to the canvas

lessonAnswer.does: answer a lesson's question and check it

setAnswer.does: choose an answer without checking it

loadCase.does: load a lesson case's programme (as given, or fixed)

shippedVerdict.does: the verdict Python computed for a lesson case when the page was built

seekTo.does: move the animation to a named point of the programme

fit.does: fit the device to the canvas

snapshot.does: the whole document as a snapshot

restore.does: replaces the whole document from a snapshot; the person's to do

autosaveSoon.does: schedules a write to the person's browser storage

importText.does: replaces the whole document from a file's text; the person's to do

snapshotOf.does: parse a snapshot, .arch.json or edit list without applying it
